text_1.title: Payload
text_1.description: JSON from the Issue Board screen

Create_problem.inputs: @if(less(length(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['title'], ''))), 4), 'The title must be at least 4 characters.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['application'], ''))), 'Pick an application.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['section'], ''))), 'Pick a section.', if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['description'], ''))), 'Describe what happened.', ''))))

Comment_problem.inputs: @if(empty(trim(coalesce(outputs('Payload')?['content'], ''))), 'Write a comment first.', if(not(or(equals(toLower(coalesce(body('Get_ticket')?['ReporterEmail'], '')), outputs('Caller')), outputs('Is_admin'))), 'You can only comment on your own issues.', if(equals(body('Get_ticket')?['IsArchived'], true), 'This issue is archived.', '')))
